input.quote: 8.1 By Commerce One. Commerce One shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Corio and its Customers from any and all damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) incurred by Corio or its Customers arising out of any claim that the Software infringes any patent, copyright, trademark or trade right secret of a third party
input.rationale: Section 8.1 does provide a vendor-side third-party IP infringement indemnity for the Software in favour of Corio and its Customers, with standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics and procure-modify-refund remedies, and Section 9 carves Section 8 out of the liability cap, so the core IP limb of the rule is satisfied and there is no offsetting Corio indemnity. However, the indemnity is confined to IP infringement: there is no cover for Commerce One's breach of applicable law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Corio/Customer data caused by Commerce One, or its gross negligence or wilful misconduct. We therefore added those heads as a new Section 8.3, incorporating the Section 8.1 procedure, leaving the existing infringement exclusions in 8.2 untouched.

proposal.summary: Add Commerce One indemnity heads for breach of law, data security incidents and gross negligence/wilful misconduct alongside the existing IP indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 8 gives us only an IP infringement indemnity, so we have added the standard further heads – Commerce One's breach of applicable law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Corio or Customer data caused by Commerce One, and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct – using the same notice, control and cooperation procedure already agreed in Section 8.1. Our position is that the supplier carries these risks; if helpful we can discuss capping these additional heads (but not the IP indemnity) at a multiple of annual fees.

ops.text: 8.3 Additional Indemnity. In addition to Section 8.1, Commerce One shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Corio, its affiliates and its Customers from any and all damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of any third-party claim to the extent resulting from (i) Commerce One's breach of applicable law; (ii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Corio's or its Customers' data caused by Commerce One; or (iii) Commerce One's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The notice, control, settlement and cooperation procedures set forth in Section 8.1 shall apply to any claim under this Section 8.3.
